mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPI increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or the correlation between RSAFS declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.5 percentage points and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100,000 jobs, the combined signal indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances during recessions despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during recessions.

mechanism_narrative: In an economic expansion regime, a sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances during expansions despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during expansions.
